text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tanino Gimlet—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... I can hear them... I can 
hear them...! The whispers of maidens 
beckoning me from inside the box...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it must have entered your sight 
as well. That sealed-away frozen hell...! 
And the flesh intertwined within it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Tanino Gimlet 
pointed, there was a crane game filled 
with plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Those who squander silver coins on games 
of chance are... like hunters intoxicated 
by the thrill of the moment.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"No... A king who threw caution to the 
wind and fell in love with a statue in 
search of the ideal maiden...?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...! Bwahahahahaha!! Either way, 
that just goes to show the sheer scale of 
the treasure sleeping here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she has an interest in claw 
machines... and by extension, plushies.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll give it a shot, too.
Maybe I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho, intriguing. So you, too, have 
perceived the beauty in this game.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well. I shall remain a bystander to 
fate. Now, let the great war begin...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
